name: Input Request in a Loop
hint: A fast loop tests a robot sensor and immediately performs an action without waiting for the triggering condition to clear. One physical event can therefore be accepted repeatedly, causing duplicated actions or state changes.
instruction: Wait until the condition is false, detect an edge, or use a debounce state so the loop accepts a new event only after the previous one has ended.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when Codey starts up :: events hat
forever
if <@codeyB shaken ? :: sensing> then
change [aas v] by (1)
end
end
